Exit Seat Information
The FAA has established standards for persons who sit in
rows next to exits. The functions that a passenger may
have to perform in an emergency and the criteria for
selecting passengers who sit in an exit seat are detailed
on this card.
An airline may not allow a person to occupy an exit seat
if that person may be unable to perform one or more
functions listed in paragraph (B) because -
(A) Passenger selection criteria:
• The person lacks sufficient mobility, strength, or
dexterity in both arms and hands, and both legs:
- to reach upward, sideways and downward to the
location of the emergency exit mechanism;
- to grasp and push, pull, turn or otherwise manipulate
those mecanisms;
- to push, shove, pull, or otherwise open emergency
- to lift out, hold, deposit on nearby seats, or maneuver
over the seat backs to the next row, objects the size
and weight of over-wing exit doors;
- to remove obstructions similar in size and weight to
over-wing exit doors;
- to reach the emergency exit expeditiously;
- to maintain balance while removing obstructions;
•The person isless than 15 years of age or lacks the
capacity to perform one or more of the functions listed
in paragraph (B) without the assistance of an adult
companion, parent, or other relative.
•The person lacks the ability to read and understand
instructions related to emergency evacuation provided
by the airline in printed or graphic form or the ability to
understand oral crew commands in the English
• The person lacks sufficient visual capacity to perform
one or more of the functions listed in paragraph (B)
without the assistance of visual aids beyond contact
• The person lacks sufficient aural capacity to hear and
understand instructions shouted by a crewmember
without assistance beyond a hearing aid; the person
lacks the ability to adequately impart information orally
The person has a condition or responsibilities, such as
caring for small children, that may prevent the person
from performing one or more of the functions listed in
paragraph (B), or a condition that might cause the person
harm if he or she performs one or more of the listed
functions.
(B) Passenger Functions:
• Locate the emergency exit;
• Recognize the emergency exit opening mechanism;
• Comprehend instructions for operating the emergency
exit;
• Operate the emergency exit;
• Assess whether opening the emergency exit will
increase the hazards to which passengers may be
exposed;
• Follow oral directions and hand signals given by a
crewmember;
• Stow or secure the emergency exit door so that it will
not impede use of the exit;
• Pass expeditiously through the emergency exit; and
• Assess, select, and follow a safe path away from the
emergency exit.
Each passenger shall comply with the instructions given
by a crewmember.
Passengers should identify themselves to allow reseating
if they;
• Cannot meet the selection criteria outlined in
paragraph (A);
• Have a nondiscernable condition that will prevent him
or her from performing any of the funcions in
paragraph (B);
• May suffer bodily harm as a result of performing the
functions in paragraph (B);
• Do not wish to perform these functions.
Passengers requesting reseating need not disclose the
reason for the request.
A passenger who is denied boarding as a result of this
regulation should contact the local airline Complaint
Resolution Official.
ATTENTION: Federal Aviation Regulations require passenger compliance with the
lighted passenger information signs, posted placards and crewmember instructions.
ATTENTION: Les Réglementations de la Direction Générale de l'Aviation Civile demande que
le passager se conforme avec les symboles des indicateurs lumineux des sieges des
passagers, des pancartes affichées et des instructions des membres d'équipage.
Las leyes federales de aviación requieren que los pasajeros cumplan con la información en los
letreros iluminados, los carteles de aviso, y las instrucciones de la tripulación.
It is recommended that seat belts be fastened when seated.
Il est recommandé de boucler les ceintures de sécurité en position assise.
Se aconseja mantener el cinturón de seguridad abrochado.
Certain portable electronic devices may not be used during this flight. Contact a
crewmember for information.
Certains appareils portables électroniques ne pourront pas être utilisés pendant le vol.
Contactez la crewmember pour plus d'intormations.
No se permite el uso de ciertos aparatos electrónicos portátiles durante este vuelo. Pida más
información a la tripulación de la cabina de pasajeros.
